message.content: In Christian theology, the figure most central to the faith is Jesus Christ. While Christianity recognizes many prophets—such as Moses, Isaiah, and John the Baptist—Jesus is viewed as the fulfillment of the prophetic tradition and the ultimate revelation of God’s plan for humanity. Thus, within Christian belief, Jesus is considered the most pivotal prophetic figure.
